definitions.explanation: Caused or created by human action rather than by natural processes. Often implies that something was deliberately done or is the result of human intervention.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人為的|じんいてき}な⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧だ。
⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人為的|じんいてき}なものだった。
examples.english: The cause of the fire was man-made.

examples.japanese: {人為的|じんいてき}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}→環境破壊：15957_kankyouhakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Man-made environmental destruction is having a serious impact on ecosystems.

notes:
Used to contrast human-caused events with natural ones. Common in discussions about disasters, environmental issues, and errors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人為的|じんいてき}な⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧ (human error)
- {人為的|じんいてき}な⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (human-caused cause)
- {人為的|じんいてき}な⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ (human manipulation)
- {人為的|じんいてき}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}{破壊|はかい}→環境破壊：15957_kankyouhakai⟧ (man-made environmental destruction)

FORMS:
- {人為的|じんいてき}な + noun (modifier)
- {人為的|じんいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (adverbial: artificially, deliberately)
